title: Reach result
description: Which transmitting satellites can ever be seen from Finland. See spec/stages/reach/README.md.

angle.description: Degrees, rounded to two decimals; null when it does not apply

cites.description: The sources the stage's rulebook cites, copied from it: every entry named "method", "basis" or ending in "_basis", in rulebook order. Every result carries them, so a reader sees which guideline or policy set each number.

file.description: SHA-256 of the IFIC file this came from, as intake recorded it

notices.description: Filings Downlink kept, all checked here

how.description: Filings by outcome, seen outcomes first, in rulebook order

notices.description: Every filing Downlink kept, in ascending ntc_id order

longitude.description: Fixed satellite: its filed longitude, east positive

elevation.description: Fixed satellite: the highest it appears in Finland's sky

north.description: Moving satellite: its orbit's folded tilt plus how far it sees over the horizon, over its best orbit. 90 or more means it sees over the North Pole.

orbit.description: Moving satellite: orb_id of that orbit (the lowest, on a tie)

body.description: Satellite around another body: the rulebook's code for it

groups.description: grp_id of every transmitting group of a filing that can be seen, ascending
